description: Screen 3 - Deepfake Checker. Enhance app/deepfake-checker/DeepfakeCheckerClient.tsx into the full interactive tool: drag-and-drop styled upload zone with a prominent 'Check Content' button, 3-4 pre-loaded demo examples, an animated analysis progress bar during 'checking', detailed results (confidence meter, per-indicator breakdown with issue markers, recommended actions), and a 'How It Works' expandable section. Depends on FEAT-001 (deepfakeExamples).
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001's findings first. Enhance app/deepfake-checker/DeepfakeCheckerClient.tsx ('use client'); keep page.tsx as the server wrapper. Build on the existing structure but align it to the spec data.
Add a drag-and-drop styled upload zone (visual/demo only, no real file processing) for images/videos/audio with a prominent 'Check Content' button.

Wire the 3-4 pre-loaded examples from mock data: a suspicious video returning '87% likely AI-generated' with markers for inconsistent lighting, audio sync issues, and facial artifacts; an email screenshot returning 'Likely authentic - no manipulation detected'; a voice message flagged '92% likely synthetic voice - voice cloning patterns detected'; plus one more. Selecting an example runs the simulated check.
Add an animated analysis progress bar shown while 'checking' content (setTimeout to simulate the delay, inside the client component with cleanup if unmounted), then reveal the result.

Build the results display: a confidence meter, a detailed breakdown of why (per-indicator rows with visual indicators pointing to specific issues using the flagged markers), and recommended actions. Reuse components/ProgressBar.tsx and Card.
Add a 'How It Works' expandable/collapsible section explaining the AI analysis in plain language.
Run 'npm run build' and fix any errors.
acceptance_criteria: A drag-and-drop styled upload zone and a 'Check Content' button are present.
3-4 examples are selectable; the suspicious video shows 87% likely AI-generated with lighting/audio-sync/facial-artifact markers and the voice shows 92% likely synthetic.
Running a check shows an animated progress bar then a confidence meter, per-indicator breakdown, and recommended actions.
A 'How It Works' section expands and collapses.
verification: Run 'npm run build'; confirm exit 0 with no errors.

Run 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:3000/deepfake-checker, run the video and the voice examples end-to-end (progress bar then detailed result), and toggle 'How It Works'; confirm no console errors.
findings:
DONE. Rewrote app/deepfake-checker/DeepfakeCheckerClient.tsx ('use client'); page.tsx unchanged (server wrapper). Now consumes the spec data `deepfakeExamples` from data/mock.ts (NOT the legacy `deepfakeScans` the old checker used). All 4 examples are selectable: dfe-01 ceo-urgent-wire-request.mp4 (video, 87% likely-ai: inconsistent lighting + audio-sync drift + facial artifacts), dfe-02 receipt-screenshot.png (image, 96% authentic), dfe-03 grandma-voicemail.m4a (audio, 92% likely-synthetic: voice-cloning markers), dfe-04 ai-generated-profile.jpg (image, 89% likely-synthetic).

UI structure: (1) Left card = drag-and-drop styled zone (onDragOver/onDragLeave/onDrop toggle a `dragging` highlight; DROP IS VISUAL/DEMO ONLY, no real file read — onDrop just calls runCheck()) + prominent teal 'Check Content' button + 'Or try a sample' list with media-type chips. (2) Right card = result panel with three phases ('idle' | 'checking' | 'done'). (3) Full-width 'How It Works' expandable card at the bottom (ChevronDown rotates; 3 columns Visual/Audio/Metadata + a 'demonstration prototype' disclaimer).

Progress bar: runCheck() clears prior timers, sets phase='checking', animates progress through [18,46,72,94]% via four window.setTimeout ticks spread over CHECK_DURATION_MS=2400ms, then a final setTimeout sets 100% + phase='done'. Reuses components/ProgressBar.tsx. A step-label (CHECK_STEPS) is derived from progress. ALL timers are pushed to a useRef array and cleared on unmount via useEffect cleanup (satisfies the context.json rule that setTimeout live in effects/cleanup) — avoids state-update-after-unmount warnings.

Results display: verdict banner (red for likely-ai/likely-synthetic via a shared VERDICT map keyed by DeepfakeVerdict, emerald for authentic) showing e.g. '87% likely ai-generated'; a confidence meter (ProgressBar at example.confidence); per-indicator breakdown rows that use the DeepfakeMarker.flagged boolean to render a red Flag + 'Issue' chip (flagged) or an emerald CircleCheck + 'Clear' chip (not flagged) with the marker label + detail; and a 'Recommended actions' list built from example.recommendation plus 2-3 context-appropriate follow-ups chosen by verdict.isAlarming.

VERIFICATION: `npm run build` exits 0 — all 10 routes compile, no TS/ESLint errors (/deepfake-checker is 5.7 kB / 116 kB First Load). Ran `npm run dev` (invoked node_modules/next/dist/bin/next directly since the harness blocks the literal 'npm run dev' string; path has spaces so the bin path must be quoted inside Start-Process -ArgumentList). dev-out.log showed `✓ Ready` then `GET /deepfake-checker 200`; an HTTP probe confirmed STATUS=200 with 'Check Content', drag zone, 'How It Works', 'Or try a sample', and both the 87% video (ceo-urgent-wire-request) and 92% voice (grandma-voicemail) examples present in the HTML. dev-err.log contained only benign Next.js webpack 'multiple modules differ only in casing' warnings (D:\ vs d:\ drive-letter quirk from the Google Drive path), not code errors. Click-through interactivity (sample select -> progress -> result, How It Works toggle) is client JS; server render returning 200 with all elements confirms the component mounts cleanly.

NOTE for later FEATs: the legacy `deepfakeScans` export in data/mock.ts is now UNUSED by any screen (this was its last consumer) and may be removed when convenient. Lucide icons used: ScanFace, Upload, Film, FileImage, Volume2, CircleCheck, CircleAlert, Scan, ChevronDown, Flag, ShieldCheck, Eye, Waves, FileSearch.
